title: ‘It’s peak Aussie – and it’s fantastic!’ How Australian TV conquered the world
summary: From Colin from Accounts to a certain blue heeler dog, Australian TV has swept the globe – so much so that many kids have picked up the accent. Homegrown stars and creators explain how down under went overground

About four years ago, parents around the world began observing a strange phenomena in their children: Australian accents. Bluey – the charming cartoon about a dog and her family that is currently one of the most watched shows in the world – had children saying words such as “dunny” and “brekky” without thinking twice.
summary_zh: 從《Accounts》中的科林到一隻藍色高跟狗，澳洲電視風靡全球，以至於許多孩子都學會了澳洲的口音。本土明星和創作者解釋了地下是如何走向地下的
大約四年前，世界各地的父母開始在他們的孩子身上觀察到一種奇怪的現象：澳洲口音。 《Bluey》是一部關於一隻狗和她的家人的迷人卡通片，目前是世界上收視率最高的節目之一。孩子不假思索地說出「dunny」和「brekky」等字眼。
